desc:
The first ever sinking ship game on Roblox to properly implement "underwater air pockets" for all of the rooms on the ship! Experience and survive a sinking ship in a way you've never experienced before!

Just to be clear, the "realistic" part refers to the fact that rooms can flood separately, not the water itself. Just like Stormworks.

cool features:
-Air pockets!
-Opening doors cause the room to flood if there is water outside the room!
-Glass and Doors can sometimes break under pressure, causing an unstoppable rush of water so beware!
-You can toggle the walls and underwater fog in settings to see the water level physics clearly in action!

Technical:
Terrain water isnt possible because its voxel-based and will just cause more lag. Unscripted sinking + Air pockets will cause lag too.
